name: Rochester Institute of Technology Dubai
englishBachelors: Engineering, computing, business and information technology, awarding the American RIT degree.

notes: IB entry: most degrees list a minimum of 24 points. Engineering lists 28 points and grade 4 or above in Maths, Physics and either Chemistry or Biology. RIT Dubai does not specify HL or SL for these three grades. Meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission.

IB Career-related Programme: several non-engineering sections list a relevant BTEC Level 3 (90 credits, grade PP or higher) plus two IB subjects at grade 3 or higher (HL or SL). Standalone IB Course Results, and this route for Engineering, are not confirmed.

Selection: admission is selective and personal. RIT Dubai considers school performance in required subjects, admission test scores, the competitiveness of your school, the programme, and may use recommendations and an interview. Predicted marks are acceptable for a conditional decision until final marks arrive.

English proficiency: an English-medium IB education may qualify for a test exemption; this is not automatic. RIT lists IB English HL/SL grades 4–7 for UWRT 150 and grade 3 for UWRT 100. These are English course placements, not IB admission cutoffs.

Dates: RIT Dubai confirms applications are open for Fall 2027. The admissions page lists 15 January, 31 May and 22 August without a year, so those dates remain provisional. The page says late applications depend on space.

Placement: Engineering normally requires Maths and Physics tests before course registration. Business, Computing, Psychology and Advertising/Public Relations normally require Maths. Eligible final IB HL grades may lead to an exemption; check which applies with RIT Dubai.

Tuition: RIT’s published bachelor payment plan gives AED 68,000 per academic year in one payment, AED 70,200 in two instalments, or AED 71,600 in eight. The plan is headed Fall 2023 onward; Fall 2027 fees are not confirmed.

Scholarships: academic awards of 5% to 45% by high school percentage (80% to 98%+), plus a 30% Dean's award; apply after acceptance. The page gives no IB conversion; ask how IB results are mapped. Awards last one academic year and are re-evaluated.

English test scores, if required: full admission lists Academic IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 79, TOEFL ITP 550 or EmSAT English 1550. For conditional admission, Academic IELTS 5.0–6.0 or TOEFL iBT 61–78. Home-based TOEFL, IELTS General Training, IELTS Indicator, Duolingo and PTE are not accepted.

Industrial Engineering: the typical five-year, 129-credit plan includes four work blocks, totalling 48 weeks of co-op. RIT Dubai does not charge tuition or institute fees while you are on co-op. A placement is not guaranteed; the careers office helps students look.
Campus: RIT Dubai offers an official online tour through its Visit page in the sources below. The photo on this guide shows Dubai Creek, not the university campus.

programmes.overview: The first two years cover mathematics, physics, chemistry, liberal arts and engineering sciences; the third and fourth years emphasise engineering science, design and systems.
